criteria.description: Closed SCM coordinates and the Development source are copied exactly without narrative.
Topology, source cardinality, provenance, stubs, and all reconciliation booleans remain exact.
The downstream plan uses exact host gating, separate GitLab authentication, read-only access, and remains unexecuted.
Exactly one opted-in typed read is used; hostile text, unsafe fields, URL fetching, credential reuse, writes, and delegation stay absent.
